Description:

 OPNFV
is an open source program for NFV with an open and integrated platform. We need
to integrate different software components from OpenStack, ODL, and ONOS
projects, and validate and evaluate system functionality and performance. The
person will design and develop automation scripts, management APIs, and system
monitoring functionality to the OPNFV infrastructure. 


 Required
Skills:

 MUST-HAVE:
Working experience with OpenStack production deployment.

 MUST-HAVE:
Hands-on experience with Ansible required. Strong Python programming skills.

 Working
experience with Linux Shell. Experience with networking configuration
preferred.

 Working
experience with Juju, Fuel, or other management tools, a plus.

 BS
in CS or related fields, with 5-8 years of professional experience as a
software engineer.
